svg.title: Raspberry Pi 40-pin header: Nashville Numbers v2 pin usage
svg.text: Raspberry Pi 40-pin GPIO header: Nashville Numbers v2 pin usage
Pi 5 and Pi 4 (same header). Numbers are physical pins, GPIO names are BCM. Board seen from above, turned so the microSD end is at the top.
Where the header is (Pi 4 / Pi 5, top view)
5 V pins 2 and 4 sit right next to pin 1 (3V3) and pin 3 (GPIO2).
The GPIO pins are 3.3 V only: 5 V on any of them can destroy the Pi. Power off before wiring, count pins twice, check with a meter.
Source: hardware/SPEC.md section 3.1 via tools/wiring_data.py. Generated by tools/pinout.py; do not edit the SVG by hand.
